meta.title: Attentive Care Connect | Book a psychologist
meta.description: Find a psychologist and book a session online or in person.

home.title: Find care that fits your life
home.lede: Choose from {count} psychologists and find a time that works for you.
home.privacy: Your booking details stay private. We never ask what you discuss in a session.
home.howTitle: A clear path to your session
home.step1: Choose a service and a psychologist who fits your needs.
home.step2: See open times and pick an online or in-person session.
home.step3: Keep your booking code handy to manage your appointment.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.p1: We use your contact details and booking information to manage appointments and send essential service messages.
privacy.p2: Optional check-in emails are sent only if you choose to receive them. You can unsubscribe at any time.
privacy.p3: We do not collect or store information about what you discuss in a session.
